text: CH played the house: 'honestly pretty fun.' Scariest part: first seeing the shadow and it closing in. Boring part: nothing to do but run. His picks: first-person, things to do in rooms, a smarter shadow.

Here's the plan. 1) the house as tiles you can walk around in, with doors to nowhere 2) the shadow's mind: sight, search, noise, lurking, the pause before the lunge 3) the first-person view and the game around it One step at a time, a test with each, and the skeptic checks every one.
steps: the house as tiles you can walk around in, with doors to nowhere
the shadow's mind: sight, search, noise, lurking, the pause before the lunge
the first-person view and the game around it

text: Step 1: each room becomes a 5 by 5 box with a doorway in the middle of each side that has a door. If the next room has no door there, your doorway opens onto a blank wall. Wardrobes in some corners. Mid-shove, the moving row is drawn a few tiles short of where it lands, so the rooms visibly grind past.
subject:
Tiles: the house as walls you can walk between, with wardrobes and doors to nowhere

Assisted-by: Claude Code

text: Took your change back out and ran the tests. A test went red. Fine. I believe you. This time.
bite_detail: Without this change your tests crash, so they'd notice if it went.

text: That commit has the shadow's mind in it too: the team tool sweeps up every new file at once. Next time, one file set per step.

Step 3: first person. A small raycaster draws the house in chunky pixels: striped wallpaper, plank floors, everything fading into the dark past your candle. Shove and the rooms grind past one tile at a time. Hide in a wardrobe and you turn round and watch the room through the crack. You hear its footsteps on the side they come from, your heart speeds up as it gets close, and your candle gutters. It's slower on the first floors.
subject:
First person: walk the house with a candle, rooms grind past when you shove, wardrobes to hide in, a smarter shadow you hear before you see

text: The skeptic was right: my browser test failed about half the time. The shadow sometimes found the test player at the wardrobe and ended the floor before the test could step out. The test now sends it to wait in a far corner first. Five runs in a row, all green.
subject:
